settings.title: DevJournal Settings
settings.export_desc: Export all your notes, images, and transcriptions into a single JSON file.
settings.import_desc: Import a previous backup. Warning: current data will be overwritten.
settings.storage_warning: Keys are saved exclusively in your browser's localStorage.

settings.invalid_backup: The file does not seem to contain a valid backup.
settings.api_key_required: Please enter your API key for {provider} in the settings.

editor.delete_confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to delete the content of this note?

chat.title: AI Assistant
chat.clear_confirm: Are you sure you want to clear the chat history?
chat.welcome: Hello! I am your AI assistant ({provider}). Ask me anything about your notes or ask me to summarize your progress.
chat.config_desc: Enter the API key for {provider} in the settings to enable chat.

media.no_speech_support: Your browser does not support voice transcription.

ai.optimize_prompt:
You must impersonate a biographer. Re-elaborate the following text to make it more professional, clear, and well-formatted for a personal journal. Change everything if not already done in markdown formatting. Maintain the original meaning and code blocks if present. Insert only the necessary changes without distorting the original text. Do not insert comments and do not do a final report of changes:

{text}
